# Signature regression fixtures

Provider JSON responses capture unrelated or unsuitable matches for Emilia,
Queen and Leona Lewis. They are inputs to the identity and format guards.

`daddy-yankee.png` was retrieved on 2026-10-30 from
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Firmadeyankee.png
with provider licence `PD-signature`. Native tests use this transparent dark-ink
image and generated masks; no Apple artwork is bundled or redistributed.
